g.text: GPIO choice is in pidp8-panel/board_map.h. GP28 is grounded so the firmware knows it is on this board.

g.text: Net names: COLn = matrix column n, LROWn = lamp row n, SROWn = switch row n (pidp8i gpio-common.c).

g.text: J1 takes the Raspberry Pi's place on the PiDP-8/I. U1 sits on the back of the board.

g.desc: J1 takes the Raspberry Pi's place on the PiDP-8/I. U1 sits on the back of the board.

g.text: JP1/JP2: bridge C-STD for a standard PiDP-8/I, C-SER for one with the serial-port mod.
